prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: edited replacement photograph for a premium Mealset landing-page hero, landscape 1536 x 1024.
Input images: Image 1 is the edit target. Keep the elegant dark pine seamless tabletop/background, restrained minimal art direction, lime-green Romanesco subject, and wide landscape composition with the vegetable positioned on the right. Keep the left approximately 40 percent unobstructed, very calm and dark for real HTML typography.
Primary request: Correct the unrealistic, overly perfect Romanesco in the supplied image into a credibly photographed real modest-sized Romanesco bought at a farmers' market. Make its silhouette lower, naturally irregular and somewhat asymmetric. Use imperfect uneven florets of different sizes, finite natural botanical spirals, subtle muted green color variation, a few tiny harmless natural blemishes and nonuniform texture. Give the vegetable several natural outer leaves with believable folded edges and veining, and a visible short pale stem resting on the surface, physically grounding it.
Style/medium: an actual restrained food still-life photograph, honest and elegant, as if shot on a good camera in a quiet studio. The recognizably Romanesco florets should have normal natural detail, never endlessly recursive artificial fractals. No giant monument-like vegetable. Keep the complete modest crown visible with breathing room above.
Lighting/mood: physically plausible soft window light or a large softbox from upper-left, gentle tonal transitions, an accurate contact shadow beneath the stem and leaves, restrained contrast, readable dark tones. Photographic depth: crisp main florets with subtle natural lens falloff, not every tiny point uniformly sharp. Preserve the dark pine and softly luminous lime color relationship without neon saturation.
Constraints: change the vegetable and its lighting realism as described while preserving the dark pine setting and the composition suitable for hero typography. One edited final image only. No text, lettering, labels, new props, bowls, hands, people, devices, interface, extra vegetables, floating elements or glow.
Avoid: CGI appearance, waxy finish, neon green, mathematically perfect symmetry, infinite fractal recursion, hyper-sharpening, huge conical crown, glossy plastic surfaces, artificial rim lighting, crushing shadows, magic particles, graphic gradients.
